fact: On 17 February 2021 the Secretary General of the Ministry of Civil Service met journalists' network RENJED, who said the access to information ordinance had lacked an application decree for over ten years, and review of the draft decree began.
title: Ministère de la Fonction Publique et de la Réforme Administrative : le RENJED relance les discussions sur le décret d'application de l'ordonnance portant accès à l'information publique
